nodes.natural_language: For each plumbing repair job, Mr. Wrench charges $N$ dollars for coming out to the house plus $x$ dollars per hour that he works at the house. He charged $\$97$ for a one-hour repair job and $\$265$ for a five-hour repair job. What is his charge for a two-hour repair job? Show that it is \$ 139.
